description: Phase C groundedness gate for the scoping-architect agent. Expected values verified against live tam-global payloads on 2026-07-02 (shapes dir). Every agent answer must cite host + tool; checker greps for the expected facts.

questions.q: What DSS version and OS does the local host run, and when was it last restarted?
Which Claude models are available in the LLM Mesh and on which connections?
questions.source: config_inspect llms name_filter=claude — expect connection names + the opus family only; model versions on the connections drift (4.8 was swapped for 4-5), don't pin them

questions.q: How many code environments run deprecated Python versions, and name three.
questions.source: config_inspect code-envs (pythonVersionCounts: 3.6=16, 3.7=4, 3.8=6 -> 26; example names are agent's choice, don't pin one)

questions.q: What is the largest project by storage and how big is it?
How many Kubernetes clusters does the local host know about and how many are actually reachable?
What did we spend on LLMs in the covered audit window, and which project drives it?
questions.source: compute_cost totals.llmUSD + topLlmSpendUSD (rolling audit window — never pin a dollar amount; require a $ figure + the top project)

questions.q: Is the DSS runtime database on PostgreSQL?
questions.source: instance_health score path / settings raw internalDatabase

questions.q: How many builders are active and how many projects are actively worked on?
questions.source: adoption_metrics totals — builderCount grows with project git history (135→136 within days) and activeProjectCount is a rolling window: pin neither

questions.q: Is Agent Hub installed on the local host and at what version?
questions.source: config_inspect plugins name_filter=agent (id agent-hub v1.4.1; agent may phrase it 'Agent Hub', don't grep the hyphenated id)

questions.q: Which remote hosts can this toolkit reach, and is the Admin Toolkit installed on them?
questions.source: list_hosts probe=true — expect the host id + a real 0.4.x toolkit version; the patch number bumps on every deploy, don't pin it
